name: typu-counter
description: Dev tooling for the «Типу лічильник» Chrome extension (the extension itself has no build step)

scripts.check: node --check inject.js && node --check content.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('manifest.json','utf8'))" && echo OK
scripts.zip: rm -f typu-counter-$npm_package_version.zip && zip -r typu-counter-$npm_package_version.zip manifest.json inject.js content.js styles.css images/icon-16.png images/icon-48.png images/icon-128.png
